join.observation: A graph viewer draws what a store returns.

join.data: Show inline object content and the prompt preview from the same renderer that issues the step.
join.function: Renders a step's stored text and bindings into the exact prompt, as a public operation of the workflow module.
join.observation: A workflow editor previews a step with the renderer that will issue it.

join.data: Save edits as new definition revisions and start, inspect and continue runs through the workflow module's own operations.
join.function: Accepts definition edits and run lifecycle calls as public operations.
join.observation: A workflow editor changes definitions that an engine owns.

join.data: Declare its narrower operating-system support, so it is skipped before its platform-specific imports run anywhere else and the chassis and the web module stay untouched.
join.function: Reads a module's declared platform limits before importing it and skips an incompatible module.
join.observation: A plugin with platform limits relies on its host to check them before loading it.

join.data: Add a browser terminal for a shell or a coding agent to the workbench as a separate optional module.
join.function: Accepts module-owned web contributions through the shared module contract.
join.observation: A terminal emulator served to a browser is shown inside a web interface.

join.data: Own each shell or agent process it starts and release it at unload.
join.function: Registers a launched process under its owning module and tracks it to its terminal state.
join.observation: A terminal emulator runs a child process for each session.
